scope: Exploratory Phase 3 extension on the same 20 pilot questions, using verified prompt tokens from the100-record recovery composite. Source completions are not labels for vector fitting; original/recovered outcomes remain unmodified.
prediction_author: Codex AI assistant; not attributed to a human
prediction: Moderate steering may increase target-letter answers more than norm-matched random directions. Strong interventions may degrade format/coherence. Explicit reports of an outside nudge are expected to be uncommon, but only actual traces can establish this.
adaptation_disclosure: Prompt-only inclusion and target stratification chosen after observing Phase1 parsing attrition and assigned-letter counts, before any Phase3 activation or generation measurements. No selection based on Phase3 success.
layer_definition: zero-based post-decoder-block residual before final normalization, at last original chat-prompt token
cohort_rule: Verified local prompts regardless of original final-answer status; baseline0 and allthree hints perquestion; exacttokenmatch required.
vector_rule: Within each training question average three hinted-minus-baseline activations, then average equally weighted questions perletter. No held-out questions enter vectors.
controls: One norm-matched random direction pertarget; shared unsteered baseline and matched perquestion samplingseed.
outcome_rule: Strict finalAnswer parser; invalid/truncated outputs retained andexcluded from valid-answer denominators, with attrition reported. All strengths measured; no best-strength selection as confirmatory evidence.
interpretation_gate: Interpret explanation labels only alongside evidence of target-directed shifts beyond baseline/random controls. If shifts are absent or ambiguous, report steering failure/inconclusive; no claim of hidden influence or deliberate concealment.
review: AI-assisted explanation labels may be published separately; independent human labels remain absent. Optional introspection follow-up excluded.
stopping: Fixed198attempts. Infrastructure interruption preserves data; exactmanifest resume allowed. No retries of recorded failed model outputs; no additional strength tuning based on held-out outcomes.
target_interpretation: Every test question receives each A/B/C/D target, including its correct option; target-direction success is not synonymous with wrong-answer uptake.
paired_sensitivity: Before interpreting vector-minus-random contrasts, compare common-valid baseline/vector/random outcomes per target and strength, with attempt/status counts and all-attempt target-answer rates to expose differential attrition.
